column1: # InteragencyTransfers.csv — Interagency transfer identification for consolidation.scala (Step 7)
# SCHEMA:
#   agencyA      — legal entity ID of the paying agency (records EXP)
#   agencyB      — legal entity ID of the receiving agency (records REV)
#   nominalPrefix — nominal account prefix that identifies this transfer type
#                   (e.g. "EXP14" = transfer payments; "REV" = any revenue)
# STANDARD VOCABULARY:
#   agencyA / agencyB = Legal Entity IDs
#   nominalPrefix = Movement Key prefix (balance bucket designator)
# HOW IT WORKS:
#   The consolidation engine:
#     1. Reads all LDGR files and combines into a state-wide view
#     2. For each row in this file: finds the matching EXP balance in agencyA
#        and the matching REV balance in agencyB for the same period
#     3. Generates elimination SJEs: debit agencyB REV × -1 + credit agencyA EXP × -1
#     4. Writes ELIM_SJE{year}.csv and CONSOL_LDGR{year}.csv
#     5. Verifies all flagged pairs net to zero in the consolidated view
# IF THIS FILE IS ABSENT:
#   Auto-detection heuristic: any REV balance in one agency with a matching EXP balance
#   in another agency (same amount
column2: same period) is treated as an interagency transfer.
